review.method: All 22 original PNGs visually inspected at their captured dimensions; manifest dimensions, image hashes and measured annotation bounds checked.
notes: Original PNG bytes copied unchanged from the verified CI artifact; no image retouching or generated imagery.
Measured annotation text fits its labels and targets remain visible. The corrected mobile Options checkbox uses a compact control and readable wrapped label.
Input, output and companion views retain actual browser-reported capabilities and idle/disconnected state. No physical device connection or long hardware take is claimed.
Captured macro actions, preview, metadata, loop layer and automation represent actual running application state. Batch shows preparation before execution.
The Help image-loading regression was added after this capture and requires the final integration CI; capture acceptance is not publication evidence.

images.alt: WebSoundEdit beta editor with arrows to Selection zoom, track Save / Export and Hide sound tools.
images.caption: The running workbench: selection zoom changes the view, track actions keep their explicit target, and sound tools collapse for more waveform space.

images.alt: Effects rack with echo, tape, filter, wet/dry controls and XY pad.
images.caption: An actual three-stage rack with stable effect order, individual wet/dry controls and independent XY assignments.

images.alt: Options Channel layout page with mono, stereo, 5.1 and 7.1 channel orders.
images.caption: Project layout and canonical speaker order are explicit. Output hardware capability is a separate setting.

images.alt: MIDI Options pedal mapping controls with local arm, command selection and debounce.
images.caption: Pedal mappings select a command, press threshold and debounce. Arming is a separate local action; release never retriggers.

images.alt: Macro editor showing a loop that imports, trims quiet ends, normalizes and exports files.
images.caption: Canonical text retains loops and variables. Validate before running; Record actions and Batch files use the same command language.

images.alt: Long recorder source, start/pause controls, elapsed time and written/queued storage counters.
images.caption: The long recorder before capture. Its disk archive is separate from the bounded waveform editor; counters distinguish committed and queued bytes.

images.alt: Streaming Options with empty token field, loopback endpoint and disabled destination/profile selectors.
images.caption: The disconnected companion surface. Credentials stay in memory, and destinations/profiles come from an explicitly connected local companion.

images.alt: Project dialog offering native JSON, Audacity AUP3, legacy Audacity ZIP and REAPER project ZIP.
images.caption: Genuine editable formats are separate choices. Audacity surround requires explicit speaker-labeled mono splitting; REAPER export includes its referenced media.

images.alt: Sample keys dialog showing estimated sample keys and individual manual-key selectors.
images.caption: Key estimates keep written labels and confidence alongside tonic colors. Manual overrides remain available for ambiguous material.

images.alt: Export dialog with track scope, source choice, channel layout and metadata support.
images.caption: Choose scope, exact track, format and explicit committed/live render behavior. Metadata support is reported for the selected format.

images.alt: Live loop panel containing a real captured layer and independent play, stop, mute and delete buttons.
images.caption: An actual short program capture created a new loop layer. Beat boundaries, source choice and independent layer controls are visible.

images.alt: Mobile waveform editor with direct track export and selection zoom controls.
images.caption: The real mobile workbench with sound tools collapsed. Track actions and selection zoom remain available at a narrow width.

images.alt: Mobile Options page with wrapped section navigation, theme selector and tooltip preference.
images.caption: Addressable Options on mobile keeps the current session alive and provides a global guidance switch.

images.alt: Idle Audio input Options showing microphone or display source, device, channel indices, gain, processing preferences and unchecked monitoring.
images.caption: Audio input settings before acquisition. Start input requests permission explicitly; source channels and gain are configurable, and monitoring remains off.

images.alt: Audio output Options with the real device-selection capability, monitoring layout, Apply routing button and reported maximum channel count.
images.caption: Audio output shows the browser's reported destination capability separately from the selected monitoring layout.

images.alt: Audio metadata dialog with a saved title and artist, other available tag fields and Save metadata button.
images.caption: The actual metadata editor after saving the title and artist. Project tags remain editable and are embedded only by formats that support them.

images.alt: Active action recorder with two genuine captured editing commands, an unchecked Record timing option and Finish recording button.
images.caption: Two successful editing commands captured without thinking time. Enable Record timing to retain elapsed waits in the resulting script.

images.alt: Visual macro editor with two real recorded effect steps, editable command arguments and accessible order controls.
images.caption: The two recorded commands shown as editable visual steps. Edit arguments and use move controls to change order; structured programs remain available as script text.

images.alt: Batch preparation page showing the chosen cleanup macro, two supplied local audio files, error policy and Run batch control.
images.caption: A saved cleanup-and-export macro with two supplied local synthesized WAV files. This is preparation before Run batch; progress, errors and collected outputs appear during execution.

images.alt: Effect automation panel with the master filter frequency selected, two linear time/value points and successful saved-lane status.
images.caption: A saved filter-frequency lane schedules 500 Hz at zero seconds and 5500 Hz at four seconds. These audio-clock points are separate from action recorder waits.

images.alt: Waveform editor with a selected region, precise selection bounds, All channels scope and a ready gain preview with Apply control.
images.caption: A real two-second region is selected and gain has been previewed. IN/OUT and channel scope define the edit; Apply commits the preview to that scope.

images.alt: Options Help and recovery page with recovery guidance links and a Clear recovery copy button that has not been activated.
images.caption: Help and local recovery controls keep the open project separate from the browser recovery copy. The Clear recovery control is shown without deleting data; save a portable session for a durable copy.
